full_judgment: 13. On perusal of the record it appears that the plaintiffs brought a suit for declaration of title and Khas possession. The suit land originally belong to Nekjan Nessa and Nesar Uddin who purchased the suit land by registered deed dated 23-4-1887 which were wrongly recorded in the CS record in the name of her husband Riazuddin. After death of her husband a suit being Title Suit No. 403 of 1916 was filed by her son Manik Molla in the court of 2nd Munsif, Manikgonj where Nekjan Nessa was defendant No.7. The suit was disposed of by amicable Solanama where title of Nekjan Nessa was admitted. Thereafter, Asiruddin purchased the suit land from Nekjan Nessa on 19-3-1917 by registered deed ext. 1ka. It further appears from exts. 3, 3ka SA and RS Khatian 337 that the suit land was recorded in the name of Asir Uddin the present plaintiff opposite-party become the owner and successor of the suit land.
